text:
maria: Quick sync — we need final copy + publish timing for the status page + customer email about last night's degraded embeddings window. Proposed: short status page entry + more detailed email 30 mins after page update. Thoughts?

alex: Agree on staged approach. Also suggest a 'what it means for you' bullet.

sam: Tone note — keep technical detail minimal, but include action steps for affected customers (retry, contact support).

jess: For translations, we need 2-hour lead to localizers. If we publish globally simultaneously, translations will lag. Suggest staggered pub per region.

maria: Good point. Proposal: status page at t0 global, email at t0+30 for NA/EU, t0+90 for APAC, localized emails later. @ops-bot can we schedule a followup?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20250325-7 — channel ops-incident-notices notified. Please add ETA for status update.

tim: I'll have a first draft in 20 min. Can we lock the subject line to 'Service Notice: degraded embeddings — resolved' or wait for full resolution?

alex: Subject should reflect current status. If resolved, say 'resolved', otherwise 'intermittent degradation ongoing'.

maria: We don't have resolution yet; keep 'intermittent degradation' and add expected next update time. Also include rolling rollback note if any.

sam: Routing: set inbound form to route any leads/questions to support-incident-queue. Marketing ops to handle templated replies.

jess: :thumbsup: I'll update translation request with staggered windows.

maria: Okay — plan: status page post at 15:04 UTC (t0), email NA/EU 15:34, APAC 16:34, translations queued. Tim pls post draft, tag me + alex for quick approve. I'll coordinate with CS for messaging.

tim: Draft ready, posting below for quick review.

tim: ```
Status page entry (short):
We are investigating intermittent degradation affecting embeddings generation for some customers. Our engineers are actively investigating and working on a fix. We will provide updates within 30 minutes.
What we're doing: prioritizing affected queues, rolling diagnostics, and applying mitigations.
What you can do: retry requests after 30s, reach out to support with request IDs.
```

alex: One more ask: add one-sentence note about potential API token rate limit spikes and a link to the retry doc.

maria: Good call. Add link -> https://redwood.ai/docs/retry-best-practices. Thx all.

maria: Final checklist: tim posts status page at t0, marketing ops schedules emails per region, jess submits translation ticket, alex + I review subject line and one-liner, sam confirms routing. If anything blocks, flag here.
